title: The Simple Oracle
text: An oracle sits in a hut of sticks, an old woman with eyes like a child's. She will speak only to the least clever of the party. She greets them like an old friend, by a name that is almost theirs.

options.label: The least sharp of you talks with her.

outcomes.text: She tells them something simple and true. They understand it better than any of you could.

options.label: The cleverest pretends to be simple to hear what she would say.

outcomes.text: She plays along and gives a clever answer.
She is not fooled, and she is hurt. The hut goes cold.

options.label: Pass her by; simple truths can wait.

outcomes.text: She waves. "You'll be back," she says, and oddly the Leader is comforted.
